sentences: I ignored what happened after finding the 7 because else only means not this one.
The loop keeps checking, so the last else does not erase the earlier match.
When 7 appeared, found became 1 and stayed locked in my mind.
The later checks for 2 and 3 are just other tries, not a correction.
Since 7 comes first, that match is the one that truly counts.
